name: Yazu (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Yazu town emblem in white: a stylised butterfly of four petal-like wings.
history: Municipal flag of Yazu, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 November 2005.

features.role: Yazu town emblem — a stylised butterfly of four petal-like wings
